segments.name: Telecommunications
segments.description: Provides mobile, fixed-line and multimedia telecommunications services to customers in Brazil under a single integrated business segment.
segments.evidence: decision makers understand that the Company represents only one business segment and does not contemplate specific strategies focused only on one service line

revenueModel.text: Customers pay TIM for mobile, fixed-line and multimedia communication services operated under its SMP, STFC and SCM licenses.
revenueModel.evidence: The aim is to maximize the result obtained by operating the SMP, STFC and SCM licenses.

changes.text: In 2023, TIM S.A. merged SPE Cozani, the entity holding the Oi Móvel assets acquired in 2022, into the company.
changes.evidence: SPE Cozani was merged into us and ceased to exist as a separate legal entity.
